SelectUnit.en: Selects (true) or deselects (false) the unit for the local player; combine with GetLocalPlayer to affect only one player.

SetAllItemTypeSlots.zh: 设置所有商店（市场）可出售的物品种类上限（栏位数）。
SetAllItemTypeSlots.en: Sets the maximum number of item types (slots) that all shops (marketplaces) can stock.

SetAllUnitTypeSlots.zh: 设置所有商店（市场）可出售的单位种类上限（栏位数）。
SetAllUnitTypeSlots.en: Sets the maximum number of unit types (slots) that all shops (marketplaces) can stock.

SetAllianceTarget.zh: 电脑 AI 脚本用：设置联盟目标单位（供盟友电脑协同进攻），可由 GetAllianceTarget 读回；只在 AI 脚本线程里有意义。
SetAllianceTarget.en: AI script function: sets the alliance target unit (for coordinated attacks with allied AIs), readable via GetAllianceTarget; only meaningful in an AI script thread.

SetAllyColorFilterState.zh: 设置盟友颜色显示模式（相当于 Alt+A 切换）：0 按玩家颜色，1、2 为按敌我区分的两种模式。
SetAllyColorFilterState.en: Sets the ally color display mode (like toggling Alt+A): 0 uses player colors, 1 and 2 are the ally/enemy color modes.

SetAltMinimapIcon.zh: 设置单位在小地图上使用的替代图标的贴图路径（配合 UnitSetUsesAltIcon）。
SetAltMinimapIcon.en: Sets the texture path of the alternate minimap icon used by units (see UnitSetUsesAltIcon).

SetAmphibious.zh: 电脑 AI 脚本用：让 AI 按两栖方式处理寻路（可跨水域的地图）；只在 AI 脚本线程里有意义。
SetAmphibious.en: AI script function: makes the AI treat pathing as amphibious (for maps with water crossings); only meaningful in an AI script thread.

SetBlight.zh: 以 (x, y) 为圆心、radius 为半径为玩家添加（addBlight=true）或清除（false）荒芜之地（不死族腐地）。
SetBlight.en: Adds (addBlight true) or removes (false) blight for the player in a circle of the given radius centered at (x, y).

SetBlightLoc.zh: 以指定点为圆心、radius 为半径为玩家添加（addBlight=true）或清除（false）荒芜之地。
SetBlightLoc.en: Adds (addBlight true) or removes (false) blight for the player in a circle of the given radius around the location.

SetBlightPoint.zh: 在坐标 (x, y) 这一格为玩家添加（addBlight=true）或清除（false）荒芜之地。
SetBlightPoint.en: Adds (addBlight true) or removes (false) blight for the player at the single cell at (x, y).

SetBlightRect.zh: 在整个矩形区域内为玩家添加（addBlight=true）或清除（false）荒芜之地。
SetBlightRect.en: Adds (addBlight true) or removes (false) blight for the player over the whole rect.

SetCameraBounds.zh: 用四个角点坐标 (x1,y1)~(x4,y4) 设置镜头可移动的范围（镜头边界）。
SetCameraBounds.en: Sets the camera bounds (the area the camera can move in) using four corner points (x1,y1) to (x4,y4).

SetCameraField.zh: 在 duration 秒内把镜头属性（如镜头距离、视野、角度等 CAMERA_FIELD_*）平滑调整到 value；角度类属性单位为度。
SetCameraField.en: Smoothly changes a camera field (distance, field of view, angle of attack, etc., CAMERA_FIELD_*) to value over duration seconds; angle fields are in degrees.

SetCameraOrientController.zh: 把镜头朝向锁定到单位（镜头随单位转向），xoffset/yoffset 为偏移。
SetCameraOrientController.en: Locks the camera orientation to the unit (the camera turns with it), with an x/y offset.

SetCameraPosition.zh: 立即把镜头移动到地图坐标 (x, y)。
SetCameraPosition.en: Immediately moves the camera to map coordinates (x, y).

SetCameraQuickPosition.zh: 设置镜头的快速跳转位置（按空格键跳到的位置）为 (x, y)。
SetCameraQuickPosition.en: Sets the camera quick position (where the Space key jumps to) to (x, y).

SetCameraRotateMode.zh: 让镜头绕点 (x, y) 在 duration 秒内旋转 radiansToSweep 弧度。
SetCameraRotateMode.en: Rotates the camera around point (x, y) by radiansToSweep radians over duration seconds.

SetCameraTargetController.zh: 把镜头锁定跟随单位（带 x/y 偏移）；inheritOrientation 为 true 时镜头朝向也跟随单位朝向。
SetCameraTargetController.en: Locks the camera target to follow the unit with an x/y offset; if inheritOrientation is true the camera also takes the unit's facing.

SetCampaignAI.zh: 电脑 AI 脚本用：把 AI 设为战役模式（区别于对战 SetMeleeAI）；只在 AI 脚本线程里有意义。
SetCampaignAI.en: AI script function: puts the AI into campaign mode (as opposed to SetMeleeAI); only meaningful in an AI script thread.

SetCampaignAvailable.zh: 设置战役菜单里第 campaignNumber 个战役是否可用（解锁）。
SetCampaignAvailable.en: Sets whether campaign number campaignNumber is available (unlocked) in the campaign menu.

SetCampaignMenuRace.zh: 按种族设置战役菜单的背景/界面风格。
SetCampaignMenuRace.en: Sets the campaign menu background/style by race.

SetCampaignMenuRaceEx.zh: 按战役序号设置战役菜单的背景/界面风格。
SetCampaignMenuRaceEx.en: Sets the campaign menu background/style by campaign index.

SetCaptainChanges.zh: 电脑 AI 脚本用：设置是否允许 AI 的队长（进攻/防守编队）发生变动；只在 AI 脚本线程里有意义。
SetCaptainChanges.en: AI script function: sets whether the AI's captains (attack/defense groups) are allowed to change; only meaningful in an AI script thread.

SetCaptainHome.zh: 电脑 AI 脚本用：设置队长的集结（家）位置；which 取 ATTACK_CAPTAIN(1)、DEFENSE_CAPTAIN(2) 或 BOTH_CAPTAINS(3)。只在 AI 脚本线程里有意义。
SetCaptainHome.en: AI script function: sets the captain's home (rally) position; which is ATTACK_CAPTAIN (1), DEFENSE_CAPTAIN (2) or BOTH_CAPTAINS (3). Only meaningful in an AI script thread.

SetCineFilterBlendMode.zh: 设置电影滤镜的混合模式（blendmode），配合 DisplayCineFilter 显示。
SetCineFilterBlendMode.en: Sets the blend mode of the cinematic filter; shown with DisplayCineFilter.

SetCineFilterDuration.zh: 设置电影滤镜从起始状态过渡到结束状态所用的时间（秒）。
SetCineFilterDuration.en: Sets how long (in seconds) the cinematic filter takes to go from its start state to its end state.

SetCineFilterEndColor.zh: 设置电影滤镜结束时的颜色和透明度（RGBA，各 0~255）。
SetCineFilterEndColor.en: Sets the end color and alpha of the cinematic filter (RGBA, each 0-255).

SetCineFilterEndUV.zh: 设置电影滤镜结束时贴图的 UV 坐标范围。
SetCineFilterEndUV.en: Sets the texture UV range of the cinematic filter at its end state.

SetCineFilterStartColor.zh: 设置电影滤镜开始时的颜色和透明度（RGBA，各 0~255）。
SetCineFilterStartColor.en: Sets the start color and alpha of the cinematic filter (RGBA, each 0-255).

SetCineFilterStartUV.zh: 设置电影滤镜开始时贴图的 UV 坐标范围。
SetCineFilterStartUV.en: Sets the texture UV range of the cinematic filter at its start state.

SetCineFilterTexMapFlags.zh: 设置电影滤镜贴图的映射标志（texmapflags，如是否平铺）。
SetCineFilterTexMapFlags.en: Sets the texture mapping flags (texmapflags, e.g. wrapping) of the cinematic filter.

SetCineFilterTexture.zh: 设置电影滤镜使用的贴图文件路径。
SetCineFilterTexture.en: Sets the texture file path used by the cinematic filter.

SetCinematicCamera.zh: 播放一个镜头模型文件里的电影镜头动画。
SetCinematicCamera.en: Plays a cinematic camera animation from a camera model file.

SetCinematicScene.zh: 显示电影对话场景：头像单位类型、玩家颜色、说话者名字和字幕文本，sceneDuration/voiceoverDuration 为场景和配音时长（秒）。
SetCinematicScene.en: Shows a cinematic transmission scene: portrait unit type, player color, speaker title and subtitle text; sceneDuration and voiceoverDuration are in seconds.

SetCreatureDensity.zh: 设置地图的野怪（中立生物）密度。
SetCreatureDensity.en: Sets the creep (neutral creature) density of the map.

SetCreepCampFilterState.zh: 设置小地图上是否显示野怪营地。
SetCreepCampFilterState.en: Sets whether creep camps are shown on the minimap.

SetCustomCampaignButtonVisible.zh: 设置自定义战役菜单中第 whichButton 个按钮是否可见。
SetCustomCampaignButtonVisible.en: Sets whether custom campaign button number whichButton is visible in the campaign menu.

SetDayNightModels.zh: 设置地形和单位使用的昼夜光照模型文件。
SetDayNightModels.en: Sets the day/night lighting model files used for terrain and units.

SetDefendPlayer.zh: 电脑 AI 脚本用：设置电脑是否出兵协防（帮助保护盟友玩家）；只在 AI 脚本线程里有意义。
SetDefendPlayer.en: AI script function: sets whether the AI sends forces to help defend (allied players); only meaningful in an AI script thread.

SetDestructableAnimation.zh: 让可破坏物播放指定名字的动画。
SetDestructableAnimation.en: Plays the named animation on the destructable.

SetDestructableAnimationSpeed.zh: 设置可破坏物的动画播放速度倍率（1 为正常速度）。
SetDestructableAnimationSpeed.en: Sets the animation speed factor of the destructable (1 is normal speed).

SetDestructableInvulnerable.zh: 设置可破坏物是否无敌（true 为无敌）。
SetDestructableInvulnerable.en: Sets whether the destructable is invulnerable (true = invulnerable).

SetDestructableLife.zh: 设置可破坏物的当前生命值。
SetDestructableLife.en: Sets the current life of the destructable.

SetDestructableMaxLife.zh: 设置可破坏物的最大生命值。
SetDestructableMaxLife.en: Sets the maximum life of the destructable.

SetDestructableOccluderHeight.zh: 设置可破坏物的遮挡高度（影响视线/镜头遮挡）。
SetDestructableOccluderHeight.en: Sets the occluder height of the destructable (affects line-of-sight / camera occlusion).

SetDoodadAnimation.zh: 让以 (x, y) 为圆心、radius 为半径内指定类型的装饰物播放动画；nearestOnly 为 true 只作用于最近的一个，animRandom 为 true 随机选动画变体。
SetDoodadAnimation.en: Plays an animation on doodads of type doodadID within radius of (x, y); nearestOnly affects only the nearest one, animRandom picks a random animation variation.

SetDoodadAnimationRect.zh: 让矩形区域内指定类型的装饰物播放动画；animRandom 为 true 随机选动画变体。
SetDoodadAnimationRect.en: Plays an animation on doodads of type doodadID inside the rect; animRandom picks a random animation variation.

SetEdCinematicAvailable.zh: 设置战役菜单里第 campaignNumber 个战役的过场动画是否可观看。
SetEdCinematicAvailable.en: Sets whether the cinematic for campaign number campaignNumber is available to watch in the campaign menu.

SetExpansion.zh: 电脑 AI 脚本用：命令农民去建造类型为 id 的分矿建筑，返回是否成功下令；只在 AI 脚本线程里有意义。
SetExpansion.en: AI script function: orders the worker to build an expansion building of type id; returns whether the order succeeded. Only meaningful in an AI script thread.

SetFloatGameState.zh: 设置一个实数型游戏状态的值，例如 GAME_STATE_TIME_OF_DAY（当前游戏内时刻）。
SetFloatGameState.en: Sets a real-valued game state, e.g. GAME_STATE_TIME_OF_DAY (current in-game time of day).

SetFogStateRadius.zh: 对玩家把以 (centerx, centerY) 为中心、半径 radius 的圆形区域设为指定迷雾状态（可见/迷雾/黑色阴影）；useSharedVision 表示是否一并考虑共享视野。
SetFogStateRadius.en: Sets the fog state (visible/fogged/masked) of a circle at (centerx, centerY) with the given radius for a player; useSharedVision controls whether shared vision is taken into account.

SetFogStateRadiusLoc.zh: 同 SetFogStateRadius，圆心用点（location）给出：对玩家把该圆形区域设为指定迷雾状态。
SetFogStateRadiusLoc.en: Same as SetFogStateRadius but the center is given as a location: sets the fog state of that circle for a player.

SetFogStateRect.zh: 对玩家把矩形区域 where 设为指定迷雾状态（可见/迷雾/黑色阴影）；useSharedVision 表示是否一并考虑共享视野。
SetFogStateRect.en: Sets the fog state (visible/fogged/masked) of rect 'where' for a player; useSharedVision controls whether shared vision is taken into account.

SetGameDifficulty.zh: 设置游戏难度（主要用于战役，影响按难度区分的触发和数值）。
SetGameDifficulty.en: Sets the game difficulty (mainly for campaigns; affects difficulty-dependent triggers and values).

SetGamePlacement.zh: 设置玩家出生点的分配方式（固定、随机、按队伍等），一般在地图配置（config）阶段调用。
SetGamePlacement.en: Sets how start locations are assigned (fixed, random, by team, etc.); normally called during map configuration (config).

SetGameSpeed.zh: 设置游戏速度（MAP_SPEED_SLOWEST / SLOW / NORMAL / FAST / FASTEST 等常量）。
SetGameSpeed.en: Sets the game speed (MAP_SPEED_SLOWEST / SLOW / NORMAL / FAST / FASTEST constants).

SetGameTypeSupported.zh: 设置地图是否支持某种游戏类型（如混战、自由对战、团队对战），value 为 true 表示支持；用于地图配置阶段。
SetGameTypeSupported.en: Declares whether the map supports a game type (melee, free-for-all, team play, etc.); value true = supported. Used during map configuration.

SetGroupsFlee.zh: 电脑 AI 脚本用：设置 AI 的部队（整组）在劣势时是否会撤退逃跑；只在 AI 脚本线程里有意义。
SetGroupsFlee.en: AI script only: sets whether the computer's attack groups flee when losing. Meaningful only inside an AI script thread.

SetHeroAgi.zh: 设置英雄的敏捷值为 newAgi；permanent 表示是否为永久修改（通常传 true）。
SetHeroAgi.en: Sets a hero's agility to newAgi; permanent marks the change as permanent (usually true).

SetHeroInt.zh: 设置英雄的智力值为 newInt；permanent 表示是否为永久修改（通常传 true）。
SetHeroInt.en: Sets a hero's intelligence to newInt; permanent marks the change as permanent (usually true).

SetHeroLevel.zh: 把英雄等级提升到 level；showEyeCandy 为 true 时显示升级特效。只能升级不能降级，降级请用 UnitStripHeroLevel。
SetHeroLevel.en: Raises a hero to the given level; showEyeCandy shows the level-up effect. It cannot lower the level (use UnitStripHeroLevel for that).

SetHeroLevels.zh: 电脑 AI 脚本用（common.ai）：注册一个回调函数，AI 英雄升级时由它返回要学习的技能 ID；只在 AI 脚本线程里有意义。
SetHeroLevels.en: AI script only (common.ai): registers a callback that returns the ability ID an AI hero should learn when it levels up. Meaningful only in an AI script thread.

SetHeroStr.zh: 设置英雄的力量值为 newStr；permanent 表示是否为永久修改（通常传 true）。
SetHeroStr.en: Sets a hero's strength to newStr; permanent marks the change as permanent (usually true).

SetHeroXP.zh: 设置英雄的经验值为 newXpVal，经验足够时会随之升级；showEyeCandy 为 true 时显示升级特效。
SetHeroXP.en: Sets a hero's experience to newXpVal (the hero levels up if the XP is enough); showEyeCandy shows the level-up effect.

SetHeroesBuyItems.zh: 电脑 AI 脚本用（common.ai）：设置 AI 英雄是否会去商店购买物品；只在 AI 脚本线程里有意义。
SetHeroesBuyItems.en: AI script only (common.ai): sets whether AI heroes buy items from shops. Meaningful only in an AI script thread.

SetHeroesFlee.zh: 电脑 AI 脚本用：设置 AI 英雄在危险（如残血）时是否会逃跑；只在 AI 脚本线程里有意义。
SetHeroesFlee.en: AI script only: sets whether AI heroes flee when in danger (e.g. low health). Meaningful only in an AI script thread.

SetHeroesTakeItems.zh: 电脑 AI 脚本用（common.ai）：设置 AI 英雄是否会拾取地上的物品；只在 AI 脚本线程里有意义。
SetHeroesTakeItems.en: AI script only (common.ai): sets whether AI heroes pick up items lying on the ground. Meaningful only in an AI script thread.

SetIgnoreInjured.zh: 电脑 AI 脚本用（common.ai）：设置 AI 是否忽略单位受伤状态（与受伤单位是否撤回休整有关）；只在 AI 脚本线程里有意义。
SetIgnoreInjured.en: AI script only (common.ai): sets whether the AI ignores units being injured (related to pulling back injured units). Meaningful only in an AI script thread.

SetImageAboveWater.zh: 设置图像（image）是否绘制在水面之上；useWaterAlpha 表示是否使用水的透明度。
SetImageAboveWater.en: Sets whether an image is drawn above water; useWaterAlpha makes it use the water's alpha.

SetImageColor.zh: 设置图像的颜色和透明度，red/green/blue/alpha 取 0~255。
SetImageColor.en: Sets an image's color and alpha; red/green/blue/alpha are 0-255.

SetImageConstantHeight.zh: 设置图像是否保持固定高度：flag 为 true 时固定在 height 高度，否则贴合地形。
SetImageConstantHeight.en: Sets whether an image stays at a constant height: when flag is true it is drawn at 'height', otherwise it follows the terrain.

SetImagePosition.zh: 把图像移动到地图坐标 (x, y, z)。
SetImagePosition.en: Moves an image to map coordinates (x, y, z).

SetImageRender.zh: 设置图像是否渲染显示；实践中常用 SetImageRenderAlways 来显示/隐藏图像。
SetImageRender.en: Sets whether an image is rendered; in practice SetImageRenderAlways is usually used to show/hide images.

SetImageRenderAlways.zh: 设置图像是否始终渲染，是显示（true）/隐藏（false）图像的常用方式。
SetImageRenderAlways.en: Sets whether an image is always rendered; the usual way to show (true) or hide (false) an image.

SetImageType.zh: 设置图像类型，决定图层叠放：1 选择圈、2 指示器、3 遮挡遮罩、4 阴影。
SetImageType.en: Sets the image type, which controls layering: 1 selection, 2 indicator, 3 occlusion mask, 4 shadow.

SetIntegerGameState.zh: 设置一个整数型游戏状态（igamestate）的值。
SetIntegerGameState.en: Sets the value of an integer game state (igamestate).

SetIntroShotModel.zh: 设置开场（载入）画面使用的模型文件路径，主要用于战役。
SetIntroShotModel.en: Sets the model file path used for the intro (loading) shot, mainly for campaigns.

SetIntroShotText.zh: 设置开场（载入）画面显示的文字，主要用于战役。
SetIntroShotText.en: Sets the text shown on the intro (loading) shot, mainly for campaigns.

SetItemCharges.zh: 设置物品的使用次数（充能数）。
SetItemCharges.en: Sets the number of charges of an item.

SetItemDropID.zh: 设置物品的掉落单位类型 ID（unitId）；很少使用，具体效果不明确。
SetItemDropID.en: Sets an item's drop unit-type ID (unitId); rarely used and its exact effect is unclear.

SetItemDropOnDeath.zh: 设置持有该物品的单位死亡时，物品是否掉落到地上。
SetItemDropOnDeath.en: Sets whether the item is dropped when the unit carrying it dies.

SetItemDroppable.zh: 设置物品能否被丢弃；false 时无法把它从物品栏丢出。
SetItemDroppable.en: Sets whether an item can be dropped; false means it cannot be dropped from the inventory.

SetItemInvulnerable.zh: 设置物品是否无敌（true 时不会被攻击摧毁）。
SetItemInvulnerable.en: Sets whether an item is invulnerable (true = cannot be destroyed by attacks).

SetItemPawnable.zh: 设置物品能否卖给商店（典当）。
SetItemPawnable.en: Sets whether an item can be sold (pawned) to a shop.

SetItemPlayer.zh: 设置物品的所属玩家；changeColor 为 true 时物品颜色改为该玩家颜色。
SetItemPlayer.en: Sets the owning player of an item; changeColor true also recolors it to that player's color.

SetItemPosition.zh: 把物品移动到地图坐标 (x, y)。
SetItemPosition.en: Moves an item to map coordinates (x, y).

SetItemTypeSlots.zh: 设置商店单位可出售的物品类型栏位数。
SetItemTypeSlots.en: Sets how many item-type slots a shop unit has for items it sells.

SetItemUserData.zh: 给物品设置一个自定义整数值（自定义值），可用 GetItemUserData 读回。
SetItemUserData.en: Stores a custom integer (user data) on an item; read it back with GetItemUserData.

SetItemVisible.zh: 显示或隐藏物品（show 为 false 时隐藏）；只对放在地上的物品有意义。
SetItemVisible.en: Shows or hides an item (show false = hidden); only meaningful for items lying on the ground.

SetLightningColor.zh: 设置闪电效果的颜色和透明度，r/g/b/a 取 0~1；返回是否设置成功。
SetLightningColor.en: Sets a lightning effect's color and alpha (r/g/b/a in 0-1); returns whether it succeeded.

SetMapDescription.zh: 设置地图描述文字，用于地图配置阶段。
SetMapDescription.en: Sets the map description text; used during map configuration.

SetMapFlag.zh: 开关某个地图标志（mapflag），如 MAP_FOG_HIDE_TERRAIN、MAP_LOCK_RESOURCE_TRADING 等；value 为 true 表示开启。
SetMapFlag.en: Turns a map flag (mapflag) on or off, e.g. MAP_FOG_HIDE_TERRAIN, MAP_LOCK_RESOURCE_TRADING; value true = enabled.

SetMapMusic.zh: 设置地图背景音乐列表（可用分号分隔多个文件）；random 为 true 时随机播放，否则从第 index 首开始。
SetMapMusic.en: Sets the map's background music list (several files may be separated by semicolons); random true plays randomly, otherwise starts from track 'index'.

SetMapName.zh: 设置地图名称，用于地图配置阶段。
SetMapName.en: Sets the map name; used during map configuration.

SetMeleeAI.zh: 电脑 AI 脚本用（common.ai）：把当前 AI 设为对战（melee）模式，一般在对战 AI 脚本开头调用；只在 AI 脚本线程里有意义。
SetMeleeAI.en: AI script only (common.ai): puts the AI into melee mode, usually called at the start of a melee AI script. Meaningful only in an AI script thread.

SetMissionAvailable.zh: 战役用：设置第 campaignNumber 个战役的第 missionNumber 关是否可选（解锁关卡）。
SetMissionAvailable.en: Campaign use: sets whether mission missionNumber of campaign campaignNumber is available (unlocks the mission).

SetMusicPlayPosition.zh: 把当前音乐的播放位置设为 millisecs（毫秒）。
SetMusicPlayPosition.en: Sets the current music's play position to millisecs (milliseconds).

SetNewHeroes.zh: 电脑 AI 脚本用（common.ai）：设置 AI 是否会训练新的英雄；只在 AI 脚本线程里有意义。
SetNewHeroes.en: AI script only (common.ai): sets whether the AI trains new heroes. Meaningful only in an AI script thread.

SetOpCinematicAvailable.zh: 战役用：设置第 campaignNumber 个战役的开场动画是否可观看。
SetOpCinematicAvailable.en: Campaign use: sets whether the opening cinematic of campaign campaignNumber is available.

SetPeonsRepair.zh: 电脑 AI 脚本用（common.ai）：设置 AI 的农民是否会自动修理建筑；只在 AI 脚本线程里有意义。
SetPeonsRepair.en: AI script only (common.ai): sets whether AI workers repair buildings. Meaningful only in an AI script thread.

SetPlayerAbilityAvailable.zh: 设置某技能（abilid 技能 ID）对玩家是否可用；avail 为 false 时该玩家所有单位的此技能被禁用。
SetPlayerAbilityAvailable.en: Sets whether an ability (abilid) is available to a player; avail false disables it for all of that player's units.

SetPlayerAlliance.zh: 设置 sourcePlayer 对 otherPlayer 的某项联盟设置（如不侵犯、共享视野、共享单位控制），value 为 true 表示开启；是单向的。
SetPlayerAlliance.en: Sets one alliance setting (e.g. passive, shared vision, shared control) from sourcePlayer toward otherPlayer; value true = on. It is one-directional.

SetPlayerColor.zh: 设置玩家颜色；已有单位的颜色不会自动跟着变（需要逐个 SetUnitColor）。
SetPlayerColor.en: Sets a player's color; existing units are not recolored automatically (use SetUnitColor on each).

SetPlayerController.zh: 设置玩家的控制者类型（用户、电脑、可营救、中立、观察者等），用于地图配置阶段。
SetPlayerController.en: Sets a player's controller type (user, computer, rescuable, neutral, observer, etc.); used during map configuration.

SetPlayerHandicap.zh: 设置玩家的生命障碍（让分），1.0 表示 100% 生命值。
SetPlayerHandicap.en: Sets a player's handicap (health), 1.0 = 100% hit points.

SetPlayerHandicapXP.zh: 设置玩家英雄的经验获取比例，1.0 表示 100%。
SetPlayerHandicapXP.en: Sets a player's experience handicap (XP gain rate), 1.0 = 100%.

SetPlayerOnScoreScreen.zh: 设置玩家是否出现在游戏结束的得分界面上。
SetPlayerOnScoreScreen.en: Sets whether a player appears on the end-of-game score screen.

SetPlayerRacePreference.zh: 设置玩家的种族偏好（racepreference），用于地图配置阶段。
SetPlayerRacePreference.en: Sets a player's race preference (racepreference); used during map configuration.

SetPlayerRaceSelectable.zh: 设置玩家在游戏大厅里能否自行选择种族。
SetPlayerRaceSelectable.en: Sets whether a player can choose their race in the game lobby.

SetPlayerStartLocation.zh: 把玩家的出生点设为编号 startLocIndex 的出生点，用于地图配置阶段。
SetPlayerStartLocation.en: Assigns start location number startLocIndex to a player; used during map configuration.

SetPlayerState.zh: 设置玩家的状态值（playerstate），如黄金、木材、人口上限等。
SetPlayerState.en: Sets a player state value (playerstate), e.g. gold, lumber, food cap.

SetPlayerTaxRate.zh: 设置 sourcePlayer 给 otherPlayer 的资源分成比例（百分比）；whichResource 为黄金或木材对应的 playerstate。
SetPlayerTaxRate.en: Sets the tax rate (percent) of a resource that sourcePlayer shares with otherPlayer; whichResource is the gold or lumber playerstate.

SetPlayerTeam.zh: 设置玩家所在的队伍编号，用于地图配置阶段。
SetPlayerTeam.en: Sets a player's team number; used during map configuration.

SetPlayerTechMaxAllowed.zh: 设置玩家某科技/单位/建筑类型（techid）的最大允许数量；0 表示禁用，-1 表示不限。
SetPlayerTechMaxAllowed.en: Sets the maximum allowed count of a tech/unit/building type (techid) for a player; 0 = disabled, -1 = unlimited.

SetPlayerTechResearched.zh: 把玩家某项科技（techid）的研究等级设为 setToLevel。
SetPlayerTechResearched.en: Sets a player's research level of a tech (techid) to setToLevel.

SetPlayerUnitsOwner.zh: 按名字是把该玩家的单位归属改给编号 newOwner 的玩家；很少使用，具体行为未充分验证。
SetPlayerUnitsOwner.en: By its name, transfers the player's units to the player with index newOwner; rarely used and its exact behavior is not well verified.

SetPlayers.zh: 设置地图的玩家数量，用于地图配置（config）阶段。
SetPlayers.en: Sets the number of players for the map; used during map configuration (config).

SetProduce.zh: 电脑 AI 脚本用（common.ai）：让 AI 在编号 town 的城镇生产 qty 个 id 类型的单位（town 为 -1 表示任意城镇）；返回是否成功下单。
SetProduce.en: AI script only (common.ai): makes the AI produce qty units of type id at town number 'town' (-1 = any town); returns whether the order was placed.

SetRandomPaths.zh: 电脑 AI 脚本用（common.ai）：设置 AI 部队行进时是否走随机路线；只在 AI 脚本线程里有意义。
SetRandomPaths.en: AI script only (common.ai): sets whether AI groups take random paths when moving. Meaningful only in an AI script thread.

SetRandomSeed.zh: 设置随机数种子；相同种子会得到相同的随机数序列。
SetRandomSeed.en: Sets the random number seed; the same seed yields the same random sequence.

SetRect.zh: 重新设置矩形区域的边界为 (minx, miny) ~ (maxx, maxy)。
SetRect.en: Resets a rect's bounds to (minx, miny)-(maxx, maxy).

SetRectFromLoc.zh: 用两个点（min 为左下角、max 为右上角）重新设置矩形区域的边界。
SetRectFromLoc.en: Resets a rect's bounds from two locations (min = lower-left, max = upper-right).

SetReplacementCount.zh: 电脑 AI 脚本用（common.ai）：设置 AI 补充损失单位相关的数量参数 qty；只在 AI 脚本线程里有意义。
SetReplacementCount.en: AI script only (common.ai): sets the AI's replacement count (quantity used when replacing lost units). Meaningful only in an AI script thread.

SetReservedLocalHeroButtons.zh: 设置本地界面左上角英雄图标按钮预留的个数。
SetReservedLocalHeroButtons.en: Sets how many hero icon buttons are reserved in the local UI (top-left hero bar).

SetResourceAmount.zh: 设置资源单位（如金矿）的剩余资源量。
SetResourceAmount.en: Sets the remaining resource amount of a resource unit (e.g. a gold mine).

SetResourceDensity.zh: 设置地图资源密度（mapdensity），用于地图配置阶段。
SetResourceDensity.en: Sets the map resource density (mapdensity); used during map configuration.

SetSkyModel.zh: 设置天空（天空盒）使用的模型文件路径。
SetSkyModel.en: Sets the model file used for the sky (skybox).

SetSlowChopping.zh: 电脑 AI 脚本用（common.ai）：开关 AI 的「慢速伐木」行为（具体效果以引擎为准）；只在 AI 脚本线程里有意义。
SetSlowChopping.en: AI script only (common.ai): toggles the AI's 'slow chopping' behavior (exact effect engine-defined). Meaningful only in an AI script thread.

SetSmartArtillery.zh: 电脑 AI 脚本用（common.ai）：设置 AI 的攻城/炮兵单位是否智能选择攻击目标；只在 AI 脚本线程里有意义。
SetSmartArtillery.en: AI script only (common.ai): sets whether the AI's siege/artillery units pick targets smartly. Meaningful only in an AI script thread.

SetSoundChannel.zh: 设置声音所属的声道（通道编号），影响它归入哪一类音量控制。
SetSoundChannel.en: Sets the channel (channel index) of a sound, which determines its volume category.

SetSoundConeAngles.zh: 设置 3D 声音的声锥：inside 内角、outside 外角（度），outsideVolume 为锥外音量（0~127）。
SetSoundConeAngles.en: Sets a 3D sound's cone: inside and outside angles (degrees) and outsideVolume, the volume outside the cone (0-127).

SetSoundConeOrientation.zh: 设置 3D 声音声锥的朝向向量 (x, y, z)。
SetSoundConeOrientation.en: Sets the orientation vector (x, y, z) of a 3D sound's cone.

SetSoundDistanceCutoff.zh: 设置声音的截止距离，超过这个距离的听者听不到。
SetSoundDistanceCutoff.en: Sets a sound's cutoff distance; listeners farther away than this do not hear it.

SetSoundDistances.zh: 设置 3D 声音的最小距离 minDist 和最大距离 maxDist（音量在两者之间衰减）。
SetSoundDistances.en: Sets a 3D sound's minimum and maximum distances (volume attenuates between them).

SetSoundDuration.zh: 设置声音的时长，单位毫秒。
SetSoundDuration.en: Sets a sound's duration in milliseconds.

SetSoundParamsFromLabel.zh: 按声音标签（soundLabel，SLK 声音表里的条目名）载入音量、距离等参数到该声音上。
SetSoundParamsFromLabel.en: Loads parameters (volume, distances, etc.) onto a sound from a sound label (entry name in the sound SLK tables).

SetSoundPitch.zh: 设置声音的音调倍率，1.0 为原调。
SetSoundPitch.en: Sets a sound's pitch multiplier; 1.0 = original pitch.

SetSoundPlayPosition.zh: 把声音的播放位置设为 millisecs（毫秒）。
SetSoundPlayPosition.en: Sets a sound's play position to millisecs (milliseconds).

SetSoundPosition.zh: 设置 3D 声音在地图上的位置 (x, y, z)。
SetSoundPosition.en: Sets a 3D sound's position (x, y, z) on the map.

SetSoundVelocity.zh: 设置 3D 声音的移动速度向量 (x, y, z)（用于多普勒等效果）。
SetSoundVelocity.en: Sets a 3D sound's velocity vector (x, y, z) (used for effects such as Doppler).

SetStackedSound.zh: 1.27 引擎中存在、但 common.j 未声明的隐藏函数（参数名为推断）：按名字推测是在坐标 (x, y) 处按声音标签设置「叠加声音」；行为未验证，慎用。
SetStackedSound.en: Hidden native present in the 1.27 engine but not declared in common.j (parameter names inferred): by its name, sets a 'stacked sound' for a sound label at (x, y). Behavior unverified; use with care.

SetStackedSoundRect.zh: 1.27 引擎中存在、但 common.j 未声明的隐藏函数（参数名为推断）：按名字推测是在矩形区域 r 内按声音标签设置「叠加声音」；行为未验证，慎用。
SetStackedSoundRect.en: Hidden native present in the 1.27 engine but not declared in common.j (parameter names inferred): by its name, sets a 'stacked sound' for a sound label over rect r. Behavior unverified; use with care.

SetStagePoint.zh: 电脑 AI 脚本用（common.ai）：设置 AI 部队的集结/中转点坐标 (x, y)；只在 AI 脚本线程里有意义。
SetStagePoint.en: AI script only (common.ai): sets the staging point (x, y) where AI groups gather. Meaningful only in an AI script thread.

SetStartLocPrio.zh: 设置出生点 whichStartLoc 的第 prioSlotIndex 个优先级槽：指向出生点 otherStartLocIndex，优先级为 priority；用于地图配置阶段分配出生点。
SetStartLocPrio.en: Sets priority slot prioSlotIndex of start location whichStartLoc to point at start location otherStartLocIndex with the given priority; used for start-location assignment during map configuration.

SetStartLocPrioCount.zh: 设置出生点 whichStartLoc 拥有的优先级槽数量，用于地图配置阶段。
SetStartLocPrioCount.en: Sets how many priority slots start location whichStartLoc has; used during map configuration.

SetTargetHeroes.zh: 电脑 AI 脚本用（common.ai）：设置 AI 是否优先攻击敌方英雄；只在 AI 脚本线程里有意义。
SetTargetHeroes.en: AI script only (common.ai): sets whether the AI focuses enemy heroes. Meaningful only in an AI script thread.

SetTeams.zh: 设置地图的队伍数量，用于地图配置（config）阶段。
SetTeams.en: Sets the number of teams for the map; used during map configuration (config).

SetTerrainFog.zh: 设置地形雾的旧接口，五个实数参数含义不明确；建议改用 SetTerrainFogEx。
SetTerrainFog.en: Legacy terrain fog setter whose five real parameters are not well documented; prefer SetTerrainFogEx.

SetTerrainFogEx.zh: 设置地形雾：style 样式（0 线性、1 指数、2 指数平方），zstart/zend 起止距离，density 密度，red/green/blue 颜色（0~1）。
SetTerrainFogEx.en: Sets terrain fog: style (0 linear, 1 exponential, 2 exponential squared), zstart/zend start and end distance, density, and red/green/blue color (0-1).

SetTerrainPathable.zh: 设置坐标 (x, y) 处地形格子对某种通行类型（行走、飞行、建造等）是否可通行；flag 为 true 表示可通行。
SetTerrainPathable.en: Sets whether the terrain cell at (x, y) allows a pathing type (walk, fly, build, etc.); flag true = pathable.

SetTerrainType.zh: 改变 (x, y) 处的地形纹理：terrainType 地形类型 ID、variation 变体、area 范围大小、shape 形状（圆形或方形）。
SetTerrainType.en: Changes terrain texture at (x, y): terrainType is the tile type ID, variation the variation, area the size, and shape circle or square.

SetTextTagAge.zh: 设置漂浮文字已存在的时间（秒），影响淡出和消失的时机。
SetTextTagAge.en: Sets how long a text tag has existed (seconds), which affects when it fades and expires.

SetTextTagColor.zh: 设置漂浮文字的颜色和透明度，red/green/blue/alpha 取 0~255。
SetTextTagColor.en: Sets a text tag's color and alpha; red/green/blue/alpha are 0-255.

SetTextTagFadepoint.zh: 设置漂浮文字从第几秒开始淡出。
SetTextTagFadepoint.en: Sets the time (seconds) at which a text tag starts fading out.

SetTextTagLifespan.zh: 设置漂浮文字的存活时间（秒）；非永久的漂浮文字到期后自动销毁。
SetTextTagLifespan.en: Sets a text tag's lifespan (seconds); non-permanent text tags are destroyed automatically when it ends.

SetTextTagPermanent.zh: 设置漂浮文字是否永久存在；true 时不会自动消失，需要手动 DestroyTextTag 以免泄漏。
SetTextTagPermanent.en: Sets whether a text tag is permanent; if true it never expires and must be destroyed with DestroyTextTag to avoid leaks.

SetTextTagPos.zh: 把漂浮文字放到地图坐标 (x, y)，heightOffset 为离地高度。
SetTextTagPos.en: Places a text tag at map coordinates (x, y) with heightOffset above the ground.

SetTextTagPosUnit.zh: 把漂浮文字放到单位所在位置，heightOffset 为高度偏移（不会跟随单位移动）。
SetTextTagPosUnit.en: Places a text tag at a unit's position with a height offset (it does not follow the unit afterwards).

SetTextTagSuspended.zh: 暂停（true）或恢复（false）漂浮文字的计时与移动。
SetTextTagSuspended.en: Suspends (true) or resumes (false) a text tag's aging and movement.

SetTextTagText.zh: 设置漂浮文字的内容 s 和字体高度 height（界面字号 10 约等于 0.023）。
SetTextTagText.en: Sets a text tag's text s and font height (editor font size 10 is about 0.023).

SetTextTagVelocity.zh: 设置漂浮文字的移动速度（x、y 方向分量）。
SetTextTagVelocity.en: Sets a text tag's movement velocity (x and y components).

SetTextTagVisibility.zh: 显示或隐藏漂浮文字；常配合 GetLocalPlayer 只对某个玩家显示。
SetTextTagVisibility.en: Shows or hides a text tag; often combined with GetLocalPlayer to show it to one player only.

SetThematicMusicPlayPosition.zh: 把主题音乐（thematic music）的播放位置设为 millisecs（毫秒）。
SetThematicMusicPlayPosition.en: Sets the play position of the thematic music to millisecs (milliseconds).

SetTimeOfDayScale.zh: 设置昼夜时间的流逝速度倍率，1.0 为正常，0 为时间停止。
SetTimeOfDayScale.en: Sets the time-of-day speed multiplier; 1.0 = normal, 0 = time stops.

SetTutorialCleared.zh: 设置教程是否已完成（战役相关）。
SetTutorialCleared.en: Sets whether the tutorial is marked as cleared (campaign related).

SetUbersplatRender.zh: 设置地面纹理贴片（ubersplat）是否渲染显示。
SetUbersplatRender.en: Sets whether an ubersplat (ground texture splat) is rendered.

SetUbersplatRenderAlways.zh: 设置地面纹理贴片（ubersplat）是否始终渲染，常用来显示/隐藏它。
SetUbersplatRenderAlways.en: Sets whether an ubersplat is always rendered; commonly used to show or hide it.

SetUnitAbilityLevel.zh: 把单位某技能（abilcode）的等级设为 level；返回一个整数（一般为设置后的等级）。单位没有该技能时无效。
SetUnitAbilityLevel.en: Sets the level of a unit's ability (abilcode) to level; returns an integer (usually the resulting level). No effect if the unit lacks the ability.

SetUnitAcquireRange.zh: 设置单位的主动索敌范围（发现并自动攻击敌人的距离）。
SetUnitAcquireRange.en: Sets a unit's acquisition range (distance at which it notices and auto-attacks enemies).

SetUnitAnimation.zh: 让单位播放指定名称的动画，如 'attack'、'stand'、'spell'。
SetUnitAnimation.en: Plays the named animation on a unit, e.g. 'attack', 'stand', 'spell'.

SetUnitAnimationByIndex.zh: 按模型内的动画序号让单位播放动画。
SetUnitAnimationByIndex.en: Plays a unit animation by its index in the model.

SetUnitAnimationWithRarity.zh: 按名称播放单位动画，并用 rarity（RARITY_FREQUENT 常见 / RARITY_RARE 稀有）挑选同名动画的变体。
SetUnitAnimationWithRarity.en: Plays a named unit animation, using rarity (RARITY_FREQUENT / RARITY_RARE) to choose among variants.

SetUnitBlendTime.zh: 设置单位动画之间的混合（过渡）时间，单位秒。
SetUnitBlendTime.en: Sets a unit's animation blend (transition) time in seconds.

SetUnitColor.zh: 设置单位的队伍颜色（只改外观，不改变所有者）。
SetUnitColor.en: Sets a unit's team color (appearance only; ownership is unchanged).

SetUnitCreepGuard.zh: 设置单位是否像野怪一样守在营地（离开后会返回原位）。
SetUnitCreepGuard.en: Sets whether a unit guards its position like a creep (returning to its camp when drawn away).

SetUnitExploded.zh: 设置单位死亡时是否爆炸（true 时死亡不留尸体）。
SetUnitExploded.en: Sets whether a unit explodes on death (true = no corpse is left).

SetUnitFacing.zh: 让单位转向 facingAngle 方向（角度，单位度，0 朝东、逆时针）；按单位转身速度转过去。
SetUnitFacing.en: Turns a unit to facingAngle (degrees, 0 = east, counter-clockwise), at the unit's turn speed.

SetUnitFacingTimed.zh: 让单位在 duration 秒内转向 facingAngle 方向（角度，单位度）。
SetUnitFacingTimed.en: Turns a unit to facingAngle (degrees) over duration seconds.

SetUnitFlyHeight.zh: 设置单位飞行高度 newHeight，rate 为每秒变化速度（0 表示立即）。地面单位需先添加再移除技能 'Amrf' 才能改高度。
SetUnitFlyHeight.en: Sets a unit's fly height to newHeight at 'rate' per second (0 = instant). Ground units need the 'Amrf' ability added and removed first.

SetUnitFog.zh: 设置单位雾效的旧接口，五个实数参数含义不明确。
SetUnitFog.en: Legacy unit fog setter whose five real parameters are not well documented.

SetUnitInvulnerable.zh: 设置单位是否无敌（true 时不受伤害）。
SetUnitInvulnerable.en: Sets whether a unit is invulnerable (true = takes no damage).

SetUnitLookAt.zh: 让单位模型的某个骨骼（whichBone，如 'bone_head'）朝向目标单位，可加 X/Y/Z 偏移；用 ResetUnitLookAt 恢复。
SetUnitLookAt.en: Makes a unit's bone (whichBone, e.g. 'bone_head') look at a target unit with X/Y/Z offsets; undo with ResetUnitLookAt.

SetUnitMoveSpeed.zh: 设置单位移动速度；受游戏常数中上下限约束（默认最高 522）。
SetUnitMoveSpeed.en: Sets a unit's movement speed; clamped by gameplay-constant limits (default maximum 522).

SetUnitOwner.zh: 把单位的所有者改为 whichPlayer；changeColor 为 true 时单位颜色换成新玩家的颜色。
SetUnitOwner.en: Changes a unit's owner to whichPlayer; changeColor true also recolors it to the new player's color.

SetUnitPathing.zh: 开启或关闭单位的碰撞寻路；false 时单位忽略碰撞，可穿过其他单位和建筑。
SetUnitPathing.en: Turns a unit's collision pathing on or off; false lets it ignore collision and pass through other units and buildings.

SetUnitPosition.zh: 把单位立即移动到坐标 (newX, newY)；会考虑地形通行性，放不下时挪到附近可通行处。
SetUnitPosition.en: Instantly moves a unit to (newX, newY); respects pathing and places it at a nearby pathable spot if needed.

SetUnitPositionLoc.zh: 同 SetUnitPosition，目标位置用点（location）给出。
SetUnitPositionLoc.en: Same as SetUnitPosition but the target is given as a location.

SetUnitPropWindow.zh: 设置单位的推进窗口角度（转身时偏差在此角度内即可边转边前进）；设为 0 时单位无法移动。
SetUnitPropWindow.en: Sets a unit's propulsion window angle (it can move while turning if within this angle); 0 prevents the unit from moving.

SetUnitRescuable.zh: 设置单位能否被玩家 byWhichPlayer 营救（flag 为 true 表示可营救）。
SetUnitRescuable.en: Sets whether a unit can be rescued by player byWhichPlayer (flag true = rescuable).

SetUnitRescueRange.zh: 设置可营救单位的营救距离（营救方单位靠近到此距离内即营救）。
SetUnitRescueRange.en: Sets a rescuable unit's rescue range (it is rescued when a rescuer comes within this distance).

SetUnitScale.zh: 设置单位模型缩放；实际只有 scaleX 生效，三轴按它统一缩放。
SetUnitScale.en: Sets a unit's model scale; in practice only scaleX is used and applied uniformly.

SetUnitState.zh: 设置单位状态值（unitstate），常用于设置当前生命值 UNIT_STATE_LIFE 和魔法值 UNIT_STATE_MANA。
SetUnitState.en: Sets a unit state value (unitstate), typically current life (UNIT_STATE_LIFE) or mana (UNIT_STATE_MANA).

SetUnitTimeScale.zh: 设置单位动画的播放速度倍率，1.0 为正常。
SetUnitTimeScale.en: Sets a unit's animation playback speed multiplier; 1.0 = normal.

SetUnitTypeSlots.zh: 设置商店单位可出售的单位类型栏位数。
SetUnitTypeSlots.en: Sets how many unit-type slots a shop unit has for units it sells.

SetUnitUseFood.zh: 设置单位是否计入人口（占用或提供人口）。
SetUnitUseFood.en: Sets whether a unit counts toward food (uses or provides food).

SetUnitUserData.zh: 给单位设置一个自定义整数值（自定义值），可用 GetUnitUserData 读回。
SetUnitUserData.en: Stores a custom integer (user data) on a unit; read it back with GetUnitUserData.

SetUnitVertexColor.zh: 给单位模型染色并设置透明度，red/green/blue/alpha 取 0~255（alpha 为 0 完全透明）。
SetUnitVertexColor.en: Tints a unit's model and sets its transparency; red/green/blue/alpha are 0-255 (alpha 0 = fully transparent).

SetUnitX.zh: 直接设置单位的 X 坐标；不检查通行性、不打断当前命令。坐标超出地图边界可能导致游戏崩溃。
SetUnitX.en: Sets a unit's X coordinate directly; ignores pathing and does not interrupt orders. Coordinates outside the map bounds may crash the game.

SetUnitY.zh: 直接设置单位的 Y 坐标；不检查通行性、不打断当前命令。坐标超出地图边界可能导致游戏崩溃。
SetUnitY.en: Sets a unit's Y coordinate directly; ignores pathing and does not interrupt orders. Coordinates outside the map bounds may crash the game.

SetUnitsFlee.zh: 电脑 AI 脚本用（common.ai）：设置 AI 的普通单位在危险时是否会逃跑；只在 AI 脚本线程里有意义。
SetUnitsFlee.en: AI script only (common.ai): sets whether the AI's regular units flee when in danger. Meaningful only in an AI script thread.

SetUpgrade.zh: 电脑 AI 脚本用（common.ai）：让 AI 研究 id 对应的升级；返回是否成功下令。
SetUpgrade.en: AI script only (common.ai): makes the AI research the upgrade with the given id; returns whether the order was placed.

SetWatchMegaTargets.zh: 电脑 AI 脚本用（common.ai）：设置 AI 是否关注「重大目标」（具体判定由引擎决定）；只在 AI 脚本线程里有意义。
SetWatchMegaTargets.en: AI script only (common.ai): sets whether the AI watches 'mega targets' (exact criteria engine-defined). Meaningful only in an AI script thread.

SetWaterBaseColor.zh: 设置水面的基础颜色和透明度，red/green/blue/alpha 取 0~255。
SetWaterBaseColor.en: Sets the water's base color and alpha; red/green/blue/alpha are 0-255.

SetWaterDeforms.zh: 设置水面是否产生波动变形。
SetWaterDeforms.en: Sets whether the water surface deforms (ripples).

SetWidgetLife.zh: 设置 widget（单位、物品或可破坏物）的当前生命值。
SetWidgetLife.en: Sets the current life of a widget (unit, item or destructable).

ShiftTownSpot.zh: 电脑 AI 脚本用（common.ai）：按名字是把 AI 城镇的参考位置移到 (x, y)；只在 AI 脚本线程里有意义。
ShiftTownSpot.en: AI script only (common.ai): by its name, shifts the AI town's reference spot to (x, y). Meaningful only in an AI script thread.

ShowImage.zh: 显示或隐藏图像（CreateImage 创建的图像），flag 为 true 显示、false 隐藏。
ShowImage.en: Shows or hides an image (created by CreateImage); flag true shows, false hides.

ShowInterface.zh: 显示或隐藏游戏界面（隐藏即进入电影模式的黑边画面），fadeDuration 为淡入淡出时间（秒）。
ShowInterface.en: Shows or hides the game interface (hiding enters cinematic letterbox mode); fadeDuration is the fade time in seconds.

ShowUbersplat.zh: 显示或隐藏地面纹理贴图（ubersplat），flag 为 true 显示。
ShowUbersplat.en: Shows or hides a ground texture splat (ubersplat); flag true shows it.

ShowUnit.zh: 显示或隐藏单位；被隐藏的单位看不见、不能选中也不参与碰撞，但仍然存在。
ShowUnit.en: Shows or hides a unit; a hidden unit is invisible, unselectable and has no collision, but still exists.

Sin.zh: 正弦函数，参数单位是弧度（角度需先乘 bj_DEGTORAD）。
Sin.en: Sine of an angle given in radians (multiply degrees by bj_DEGTORAD first).

Sleep.zh: 电脑 AI 脚本用（common.ai）：让当前 AI 线程暂停指定秒数；触发器里请用 TriggerSleepAction。
Sleep.en: AI script only (common.ai): suspends the current AI thread for the given seconds; use TriggerSleepAction in triggers.

SquareRoot.zh: 求 x 的平方根，返回实数。
SquareRoot.en: Returns the square root of x as a real.

StartCampaignAI.zh: 为指定电脑玩家启动战役 AI 脚本，script 为 .ai 脚本文件路径。
StartCampaignAI.en: Starts a campaign AI script for the given computer player; script is the path of the .ai file.

StartGetEnemyBase.zh: 电脑 AI 脚本用：开始搜索敌方基地位置，之后用 WaitGetEnemyBase 等待结果。只在 AI 脚本线程里有意义。
StartGetEnemyBase.en: AI script only: starts searching for the enemy base location; wait for the result with WaitGetEnemyBase. Meaningful only in an AI script thread.

StartMeleeAI.zh: 为指定电脑玩家启动对战 AI 脚本，script 为 .ai 文件路径（如 Scripts\human.ai）。
StartMeleeAI.en: Starts a melee AI script for the given computer player; script is the .ai file path (e.g. Scripts\human.ai).

StartThread.zh: 电脑 AI 脚本用：新开一条 AI 线程执行函数 func。只在 AI 脚本里有意义。
StartThread.en: AI script only: starts a new AI thread running func. Meaningful only in an AI script.

StopCamera.zh: 停止当前镜头正在进行的平移/移动。
StopCamera.en: Stops any camera pan or movement currently in progress.

StopGathering.zh: 电脑 AI 脚本用（common.ai）：让 AI 停止采集资源的管理。只在 AI 脚本线程里有意义。
StopGathering.en: AI script only (common.ai): stops the AI's resource gathering management. Meaningful only in an AI script thread.

StopMusic.zh: 停止播放背景音乐，fadeOut 为 true 时淡出。
StopMusic.en: Stops the background music; fades out if fadeOut is true.

StopSound.zh: 停止播放声音；killWhenDone 为 true 时停止后销毁该声音，fadeOut 为 true 时淡出。
StopSound.en: Stops a sound; killWhenDone true destroys it after stopping, fadeOut true fades it out.

StoreBoolean.zh: 把布尔值存入游戏缓存（按分类键 missionKey 和键 key），可用于跨关卡传递数据。
StoreBoolean.en: Stores a boolean in a game cache under missionKey/key, e.g. to carry data between levels.

StoreInteger.zh: 把整数存入游戏缓存（按分类键 missionKey 和键 key）。
StoreInteger.en: Stores an integer in a game cache under missionKey/key.

StoreReal.zh: 把实数存入游戏缓存（按分类键 missionKey 和键 key）。
StoreReal.en: Stores a real in a game cache under missionKey/key.

StoreString.zh: 把字符串存入游戏缓存（按分类键 missionKey 和键 key），返回是否成功。
StoreString.en: Stores a string in a game cache under missionKey/key; returns whether it succeeded.

StoreUnit.zh: 把单位（类型、英雄等级、技能、物品等）存入游戏缓存，用于跨关卡带单位，返回是否成功。
StoreUnit.en: Stores a unit (type, hero level, skills, items, etc.) in a game cache to carry it between levels; returns success.

StringCase.zh: 转换字符串大小写：upper 为 true 转大写，false 转小写。
StringCase.en: Changes string case: upper true converts to uppercase, false to lowercase.

StringHash.zh: 计算字符串的哈希整数，常用作哈希表的键；不区分大小写。
StringHash.en: Returns an integer hash of a string, commonly used as a hashtable key; case-insensitive.

StringLength.zh: 返回字符串长度（按字节计，中文等多字节字符占多个长度）。
StringLength.en: Returns the length of a string in bytes (multi-byte characters such as Chinese count as several).

SubString.zh: 取子串：从位置 start（从 0 开始）到 end（不含）的部分，按字节计。
SubString.en: Returns the substring from start (0-based) up to but not including end, counted in bytes.

SuicidePlayer.zh: 电脑 AI 脚本用：命令 AI 部队对指定玩家发动不计伤亡的「自杀式」进攻，check_full 为是否检查部队是否满编，返回是否发起。只在 AI 脚本里有意义。
SuicidePlayer.en: AI script only: orders the AI's forces to launch an all-out 'suicide' attack on the given player; check_full checks whether the force is full; returns whether it was launched.

SuicidePlayerUnits.zh: 电脑 AI 脚本用：命令 AI 部队对指定玩家的单位发动「自杀式」进攻，check_full 为是否检查部队是否满编，返回是否发起。
SuicidePlayerUnits.en: AI script only: orders the AI's forces to launch a 'suicide' attack on the given player's units; check_full checks whether the force is full; returns whether it was launched.

SuicideUnit.zh: 电脑 AI 脚本用：派出 count 个类型为 unitid 的单位进行「自杀式」进攻。只在 AI 脚本里有意义。
SuicideUnit.en: AI script only: sends count units of type unitid on a 'suicide' attack. Meaningful only in an AI script.

SuicideUnitEx.zh: 电脑 AI 脚本用：派出 ct 个类型为 uid 的单位对玩家编号 pid 进行「自杀式」进攻。只在 AI 脚本里有意义。
SuicideUnitEx.en: AI script only: sends ct units of type uid on a 'suicide' attack against player number pid. Meaningful only in an AI script.

SuspendHeroXP.zh: 暂停或恢复英雄获得经验：flag 为 true 时该英雄不再获得经验。
SuspendHeroXP.en: Suspends or resumes hero experience gain: flag true stops the hero from gaining XP.

SuspendTimeOfDay.zh: 暂停或恢复游戏昼夜时间的流逝，b 为 true 暂停。
SuspendTimeOfDay.en: Pauses or resumes the day/night clock; b true pauses it.

SyncSelections.zh: 在多人游戏中同步所有玩家当前选择的单位，会等待网络同步完成；读取他人选择前调用。
SyncSelections.en: Synchronizes all players' current unit selections in multiplayer, waiting for the network sync; call before reading others' selections.

SyncStoredBoolean.zh: 把本地游戏缓存中该键的布尔值同步给所有玩家（多人游戏中本地读取的数据需同步）。
SyncStoredBoolean.en: Synchronizes the locally cached boolean at this key to all players (needed in multiplayer for locally loaded data).

SyncStoredInteger.zh: 把本地游戏缓存中该键的整数同步给所有玩家。
SyncStoredInteger.en: Synchronizes the locally cached integer at this key to all players.

SyncStoredReal.zh: 把本地游戏缓存中该键的实数同步给所有玩家。
SyncStoredReal.en: Synchronizes the locally cached real at this key to all players.

SyncStoredString.zh: 把本地游戏缓存中该键的字符串同步给所有玩家。
SyncStoredString.en: Synchronizes the locally cached string at this key to all players.

SyncStoredUnit.zh: 把本地游戏缓存中该键存储的单位数据同步给所有玩家。
SyncStoredUnit.en: Synchronizes the locally cached unit data at this key to all players.

Tan.zh: 正切函数，参数单位是弧度。
Tan.en: Tangent of an angle given in radians.

TeleportCaptain.zh: 电脑 AI 脚本用（common.ai）：把 AI 的队长（部队集结的指挥点）瞬间移到坐标 (x, y)。只在 AI 脚本里有意义。
TeleportCaptain.en: AI script only (common.ai): instantly moves the AI captain (the force's rally/command point) to (x, y). Meaningful only in an AI script.

TerrainDeformCrater.zh: 在 (x, y) 创建弹坑形地形变形，radius 半径、depth 深度，duration 持续时间（毫秒），permanent 为 true 时永久改变地形；返回变形对象。
TerrainDeformCrater.en: Creates a crater terrain deformation at (x, y) with radius and depth; duration is in milliseconds; permanent true changes the terrain permanently. Returns the deformation.

TerrainDeformRandom.zh: 在 (x, y) 半径 radius 内创建随机起伏的地形变形，高度变化在 minDelta~maxDelta 之间，duration 和 updateInterval 单位是毫秒；返回变形对象。
TerrainDeformRandom.en: Creates a random bumpy terrain deformation within radius of (x, y), height changes between minDelta and maxDelta; duration and updateInterval are in milliseconds. Returns the deformation.

TerrainDeformRipple.zh: 在 (x, y) 创建向外扩散的波纹地形变形，可设半径、深度、持续时间（毫秒）、波数、波间距等；返回变形对象。
TerrainDeformRipple.en: Creates an outward ripple terrain deformation at (x, y) with radius, depth, duration (milliseconds), wave count, wave spacing, etc. Returns the deformation.

TerrainDeformStop.zh: 在 duration 毫秒内逐渐停止指定的地形变形。
TerrainDeformStop.en: Stops the given terrain deformation, easing out over duration milliseconds.

TerrainDeformStopAll.zh: 立即停止所有地形变形。

TerrainDeformWave.zh: 从 (x, y) 沿方向 (dirX, dirY) 推进的冲击波地形变形，distance 距离、speed 速度、radius 半径、depth 深度，trailTime 单位毫秒；返回变形对象。
TerrainDeformWave.en: Creates a shockwave terrain deformation moving from (x, y) along direction (dirX, dirY), with distance, speed, radius and depth; trailTime is in milliseconds. Returns the deformation.

TimerDialogDisplay.zh: 显示或隐藏计时器窗口，display 为 true 显示。
TimerDialogDisplay.en: Shows or hides a timer dialog; display true shows it.

TimerDialogSetRealTimeRemaining.zh: 直接设置计时器窗口显示的剩余时间（秒）。
TimerDialogSetRealTimeRemaining.en: Sets the remaining time (seconds) shown by a timer dialog directly.

TimerDialogSetSpeed.zh: 设置计时器窗口显示倒计时的速度倍率。
TimerDialogSetSpeed.en: Sets the speed multiplier of a timer dialog's displayed countdown.

TimerDialogSetTimeColor.zh: 设置计时器窗口中时间数字的颜色，红绿蓝和透明度取值 0~255。
TimerDialogSetTimeColor.en: Sets the color of a timer dialog's time digits; red, green, blue and alpha are 0-255.

TimerDialogSetTitle.zh: 设置计时器窗口的标题文字。
TimerDialogSetTitle.en: Sets the title text of a timer dialog.

TimerDialogSetTitleColor.zh: 设置计时器窗口标题文字的颜色，红绿蓝和透明度取值 0~255。
TimerDialogSetTitleColor.en: Sets the color of a timer dialog's title; red, green, blue and alpha are 0-255.

TimerGetElapsed.zh: 返回计时器本轮已经过的时间（秒）。
TimerGetElapsed.en: Returns the time elapsed on the timer in its current run, in seconds.

TimerGetRemaining.zh: 返回计时器剩余时间（秒）。
TimerGetRemaining.en: Returns the remaining time on the timer, in seconds.

TimerGetTimeout.zh: 返回计时器设定的总时长（秒）。
TimerGetTimeout.en: Returns the timer's configured timeout, in seconds.

TimerStart.zh: 启动计时器：timeout 秒后到期，periodic 为 true 时循环；到期时调用 handlerFunc（可为 null）。
TimerStart.en: Starts a timer that expires after timeout seconds, repeating if periodic is true; calls handlerFunc on expiry (may be null).

TownHasHall.zh: 电脑 AI 脚本用：编号为 townid 的城镇是否有主基地（大厅）。只在 AI 脚本里有意义。
TownHasHall.en: AI script only: returns whether town townid has a town hall. Meaningful only in an AI script.

TownHasMine.zh: 电脑 AI 脚本用：编号为 townid 的城镇是否有金矿。只在 AI 脚本里有意义。
TownHasMine.en: AI script only: returns whether town townid has a gold mine. Meaningful only in an AI script.

TownThreatened.zh: 电脑 AI 脚本用：AI 的城镇当前是否受到威胁（有敌人来犯）。只在 AI 脚本里有意义。
TownThreatened.en: AI script only: returns whether one of the AI's towns is currently threatened by enemies. Meaningful only in an AI script.

TownWithMine.zh: 电脑 AI 脚本用：返回一个带金矿的城镇编号。只在 AI 脚本里有意义。
TownWithMine.en: AI script only: returns the id of a town that has a gold mine. Meaningful only in an AI script.

TriggerAddAction.zh: 给触发器添加一个动作函数，返回该动作句柄（可用于 TriggerRemoveAction）。
TriggerAddAction.en: Adds an action function to a trigger; returns the triggeraction handle (usable with TriggerRemoveAction).

TriggerAddCondition.zh: 给触发器添加条件（Condition/Filter 生成的布尔表达式），返回该条件句柄。
TriggerAddCondition.en: Adds a condition (boolexpr from Condition/Filter) to a trigger; returns the triggercondition handle.

TriggerClearActions.zh: 清除触发器的所有动作。
TriggerClearActions.en: Removes all actions from a trigger.

TriggerClearConditions.zh: 清除触发器的所有条件。
TriggerClearConditions.en: Removes all conditions from a trigger.

TriggerEvaluate.zh: 求触发器的全部条件，全部为真时返回 true；不执行动作。
TriggerEvaluate.en: Evaluates all conditions of a trigger and returns true if they all pass; does not run the actions.

TriggerExecute.zh: 直接执行触发器的动作，不检查条件。
TriggerExecute.en: Runs a trigger's actions directly, ignoring its conditions.

TriggerExecuteWait.zh: 执行触发器的动作，并等待其执行完毕（包括其中的等待）后再继续。
TriggerExecuteWait.en: Runs a trigger's actions and waits until they finish (including any waits) before continuing.

TriggerRegisterDeathEvent.zh: 为触发器注册「指定单位/物品/可破坏物死亡」事件，返回事件句柄。
TriggerRegisterDeathEvent.en: Registers a death event for a specific widget (unit, item or destructable) on the trigger; returns the event.

TriggerRegisterDialogButtonEvent.zh: 为触发器注册「对话框按钮被点击」事件，返回事件句柄。
TriggerRegisterDialogButtonEvent.en: Registers a 'dialog button clicked' event for the given button; returns the event.

TriggerRegisterDialogEvent.zh: 为触发器注册「对话框中任一按钮被点击」事件，返回事件句柄。
TriggerRegisterDialogEvent.en: Registers an event fired when any button of the dialog is clicked; returns the event.

TriggerRegisterEnterRegion.zh: 为触发器注册「单位进入区域（region）」事件，filter 为过滤条件（可为 null），返回事件句柄。
TriggerRegisterEnterRegion.en: Registers a 'unit enters region' event; filter is an optional boolexpr (may be null). Returns the event.

TriggerRegisterFilterUnitEvent.zh: 为触发器注册指定单位的单位事件，并附带过滤条件 filter，返回事件句柄。
TriggerRegisterFilterUnitEvent.en: Registers a unit event for a specific unit with a filter boolexpr; returns the event.

TriggerRegisterGameEvent.zh: 为触发器注册游戏事件（如游戏胜利、关卡结束、存档、读档等，EVENT_GAME_* 常量），返回事件句柄。
TriggerRegisterGameEvent.en: Registers a game event (e.g. victory, end of level, save, load; EVENT_GAME_* constants); returns the event.

TriggerRegisterGameStateEvent.zh: 为触发器注册游戏状态事件：当游戏状态（如昼夜时间）与 limitval 按 opcode 比较成立时触发。
TriggerRegisterGameStateEvent.en: Registers a game state event fired when the game state (e.g. time of day) compared to limitval with opcode becomes true.

TriggerRegisterLeaveRegion.zh: 为触发器注册「单位离开区域（region）」事件，filter 为过滤条件（可为 null），返回事件句柄。
TriggerRegisterLeaveRegion.en: Registers a 'unit leaves region' event; filter is an optional boolexpr (may be null). Returns the event.

TriggerRegisterPlayerAllianceChange.zh: 为触发器注册「玩家的某项联盟设置改变」事件，返回事件句柄。
TriggerRegisterPlayerAllianceChange.en: Registers an event fired when the player's given alliance setting changes; returns the event.

TriggerRegisterPlayerChatEvent.zh: 为触发器注册玩家聊天事件：exactMatchOnly 为 true 时消息须与文本完全一致，false 时包含即可。
TriggerRegisterPlayerChatEvent.en: Registers a player chat event; exactMatchOnly true requires an exact match, false fires if the message contains the text.

TriggerRegisterPlayerEvent.zh: 为触发器注册玩家事件（如离开游戏、胜利、失败、按 Esc 等，EVENT_PLAYER_* 常量），返回事件句柄。
TriggerRegisterPlayerEvent.en: Registers a player event (e.g. leave, victory, defeat, Esc pressed; EVENT_PLAYER_* constants); returns the event.

TriggerRegisterPlayerStateEvent.zh: 为触发器注册玩家状态事件：当玩家的某项状态（如金钱、木材、人口）与 limitval 按 opcode 比较成立时触发。
TriggerRegisterPlayerStateEvent.en: Registers a player state event fired when the player's state (e.g. gold, lumber, food) compared to limitval with opcode becomes true.

TriggerRegisterPlayerUnitEvent.zh: 为触发器注册「玩家的任意单位发生某事件」（EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_* 如死亡、施法），filter 可为 null。
TriggerRegisterPlayerUnitEvent.en: Registers an event for any unit owned by the player (EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_*, e.g. death, spell cast); filter may be null.

TriggerRegisterTimerEvent.zh: 为触发器注册计时事件：游戏经过 timeout 秒后触发，periodic 为 true 时循环触发。
TriggerRegisterTimerEvent.en: Registers a timer event fired after timeout seconds of game time; repeats if periodic is true.

TriggerRegisterTimerExpireEvent.zh: 为触发器注册「指定计时器到期」事件，返回事件句柄。
TriggerRegisterTimerExpireEvent.en: Registers an event fired when the given timer expires; returns the event.

TriggerRegisterTrackableHitEvent.zh: 为触发器注册「可追踪物（trackable）被鼠标点击」事件，返回事件句柄。
TriggerRegisterTrackableHitEvent.en: Registers an event fired when the trackable is clicked; returns the event.

TriggerRegisterTrackableTrackEvent.zh: 为触发器注册「鼠标移到可追踪物（trackable）上」事件，返回事件句柄。
TriggerRegisterTrackableTrackEvent.en: Registers an event fired when the mouse moves over the trackable; returns the event.

TriggerRegisterUnitEvent.zh: 为触发器注册指定单位的单位事件（EVENT_UNIT_* 如受伤、死亡），返回事件句柄。
TriggerRegisterUnitEvent.en: Registers a unit event for a specific unit (EVENT_UNIT_*, e.g. damaged, death); returns the event.

TriggerRegisterUnitInRange.zh: 为触发器注册「有单位进入指定单位 range 范围内」事件，filter 为过滤条件（可为 null）。
TriggerRegisterUnitInRange.en: Registers an event fired when a unit comes within range of the given unit; filter is an optional boolexpr (may be null).

TriggerRegisterUnitStateEvent.zh: 为触发器注册单位状态事件：当单位的某项状态（如生命值、魔法值）与 limitval 按 opcode 比较成立时触发。
TriggerRegisterUnitStateEvent.en: Registers a unit state event fired when the unit's state (e.g. life, mana) compared to limitval with opcode becomes true.

TriggerRegisterVariableEvent.zh: 为触发器注册变量事件：名为 varName 的全局实数变量与 limitval 按 opcode 比较成立时触发。
TriggerRegisterVariableEvent.en: Registers an event fired when the global real variable named varName compared to limitval with opcode becomes true.

TriggerRemoveAction.zh: 从触发器移除指定的动作（TriggerAddAction 返回的句柄）。
TriggerRemoveAction.en: Removes the given action (handle returned by TriggerAddAction) from the trigger.

TriggerRemoveCondition.zh: 从触发器移除指定的条件（TriggerAddCondition 返回的句柄）。
TriggerRemoveCondition.en: Removes the given condition (handle returned by TriggerAddCondition) from the trigger.

TriggerSleepAction.zh: 在触发器动作中等待 timeout 秒后继续；精度较差（最短约 0.1 秒），不能在条件函数、计时器回调、ForGroup 回调里使用。
TriggerSleepAction.en: Waits timeout seconds inside trigger actions; imprecise (minimum about 0.1 s) and not usable in conditions, timer callbacks or ForGroup callbacks.

TriggerSyncReady.zh: 多人游戏同步用：等待所有玩家完成本次同步（与 TriggerSyncStart 配对，常用于同步游戏缓存数据）。
TriggerSyncReady.en: Multiplayer sync: waits until all players have completed the sync (paired with TriggerSyncStart, used e.g. to sync game cache data).

TriggerSyncStart.zh: 多人游戏同步用：标记一次同步开始，之后用 TriggerSyncReady 等待完成。
TriggerSyncStart.en: Multiplayer sync: marks the start of a sync block; wait for completion with TriggerSyncReady.

TriggerWaitForSound.zh: 在触发器中等待声音播放，直到离结束还剩 offset 秒时继续。
TriggerWaitForSound.en: Waits in a trigger until the sound has offset seconds left to play, then continues.

TriggerWaitOnSleeps.zh: 设置触发器被等待执行时，是否要等其动作里的等待（Sleep）也完成，flag 为 true 表示等待。
TriggerWaitOnSleeps.en: Sets whether waiting on this trigger also waits for sleeps in its actions to finish; flag true means wait.

UnitAddAbility.zh: 给单位添加技能，成功返回 true（单位已有该技能则返回 false）。
UnitAddAbility.en: Adds an ability to a unit; returns true on success (false if the unit already has it).

UnitAddIndicator.zh: 在单位上显示一个指定颜色的闪烁指示效果，红绿蓝和透明度取值 0~255。
UnitAddIndicator.en: Flashes a colored indicator on the unit; red, green, blue and alpha are 0-255.

UnitAddItem.zh: 把一件已存在的物品放进单位的物品栏，返回是否成功。
UnitAddItem.en: Puts an existing item into the unit's inventory; returns whether it succeeded.

UnitAddItemById.zh: 创建一件指定类型的物品并给单位，返回该物品；物品栏满时物品会留在地上。
UnitAddItemById.en: Creates an item of the given type and gives it to the unit, returning the item; if the inventory is full it stays on the ground.

UnitAddItemToSlotById.zh: 创建指定类型的物品并放进单位物品栏第 itemSlot 格（0~5），返回是否成功。
UnitAddItemToSlotById.en: Creates an item of the given type in inventory slot itemSlot (0-5) of the unit; returns whether it succeeded.

UnitAddSleep.zh: 设置单位（通常是中立野怪）是否会在夜间睡眠，add 为 true 允许睡眠。
UnitAddSleep.en: Sets whether the unit (usually a neutral creep) can sleep at night; add true allows sleeping.

UnitAddSleepPerm.zh: 设置单位是否可以一直睡眠（不受昼夜限制），add 为 true 允许。
UnitAddSleepPerm.en: Sets whether the unit can sleep permanently (regardless of time of day); add true allows it.

UnitAddType.zh: 给单位添加一种单位分类（UNIT_TYPE_* 常量），返回是否成功；并非所有分类都能添加。
UnitAddType.en: Adds a unit classification (UNIT_TYPE_* constant) to the unit; returns success. Not every classification can be added.

UnitAlive.zh: 单位是否存活（common.ai 中声明的 native；地图脚本使用前需自行写 native 声明）。
UnitAlive.en: Returns whether the unit is alive (declared in common.ai; map scripts must declare the native themselves before use).

UnitApplyTimedLife.zh: 给单位加上生命周期，duration 秒后单位死亡；buffId 为显示的计时 buff（如 'BTLF'）。
UnitApplyTimedLife.en: Gives the unit a timed life so it dies after duration seconds; buffId is the timer buff shown (e.g. 'BTLF').

UnitCanSleep.zh: 单位是否被允许在夜间睡眠。
UnitCanSleep.en: Returns whether the unit is allowed to sleep at night.

UnitCanSleepPerm.zh: 单位是否被允许一直睡眠（不受昼夜限制）。
UnitCanSleepPerm.en: Returns whether the unit is allowed to sleep permanently regardless of time of day.

UnitCountBuffsEx.zh: 统计单位身上符合条件的 buff 数量，布尔参数依次筛选：正面、负面、魔法、物理、生命周期、光环、可自动驱散。
UnitCountBuffsEx.en: Counts buffs on the unit matching the filters: positive, negative, magic, physical, timed life, aura, auto-dispel.

UnitDamagePoint.zh: 以 whichUnit 为伤害来源，delay 秒后对点 (x, y) 半径 radius 内的单位造成 amount 伤害；attack/ranged 表示是否算攻击、是否远程，并指定攻击/伤害/武器类型。
UnitDamagePoint.en: After delay seconds, deals amount damage from whichUnit to units within radius of (x, y); attack/ranged mark it as an attack and ranged, with attack, damage and weapon types.

UnitDamageTarget.zh: 让单位对目标（单位/物品/可破坏物）造成 amount 伤害；attack 是否算攻击、ranged 是否远程，并指定攻击类型、伤害类型和武器类型（影响音效），返回是否成功。
UnitDamageTarget.en: Makes the unit deal amount damage to a target widget; attack and ranged flags, plus attack type, damage type and weapon type (affects sound); returns success.

UnitDropItemPoint.zh: 命令单位把物品丢到坐标 (x, y)，返回是否成功下令。
UnitDropItemPoint.en: Orders the unit to drop the item at (x, y); returns whether the order was issued.

UnitDropItemSlot.zh: 把单位身上的物品移到物品栏第 slot 格（0~5），返回是否成功。
UnitDropItemSlot.en: Moves the item within the unit's inventory to slot (0-5); returns whether it succeeded.

UnitDropItemTarget.zh: 命令单位把物品交给目标（如另一个单位），返回是否成功下令。
UnitDropItemTarget.en: Orders the unit to give the item to a target widget (e.g. another unit); returns whether the order was issued.

UnitHasBuffsEx.zh: 单位身上是否有符合条件的 buff，布尔参数依次筛选：正面、负面、魔法、物理、生命周期、光环、可自动驱散。
UnitHasBuffsEx.en: Returns whether the unit has any buff matching the filters: positive, negative, magic, physical, timed life, aura, auto-dispel.

UnitHasItem.zh: 单位的物品栏里是否有指定物品。
UnitHasItem.en: Returns whether the unit carries the given item.

UnitId.zh: 把单位类型的内部名称字符串（如 footman）转成单位类型整数 ID；一般直接写四字符码如 'hfoo'。
UnitId.en: Converts a unit type's internal name string (e.g. footman) to its integer unit ID; usually you write a rawcode like 'hfoo' instead.

UnitId2String.zh: 把单位类型整数 ID 转成它的内部名称字符串（如 'hfoo' 得到 footman）；找不到时返回 null。
UnitId2String.en: Converts an integer unit type ID to its internal name string (e.g. 'hfoo' gives footman); returns null if not found.

UnitIgnoreAlarm.zh: 设置单位是否忽略警报（与 AI 相关），返回是否成功。
UnitIgnoreAlarm.en: Sets whether the unit ignores alarms (AI related); returns success.

UnitIgnoreAlarmToggled.zh: 单位当前是否被设置为忽略警报。
UnitIgnoreAlarmToggled.en: Returns whether the unit is currently set to ignore alarms.

UnitInventorySize.zh: 返回单位物品栏的格数；没有物品栏返回 0。
UnitInventorySize.en: Returns the number of inventory slots the unit has; 0 if it has no inventory.

UnitInvis.zh: 单位是否处于隐形状态（common.ai 中声明的 native）。
UnitInvis.en: Returns whether the unit is invisible (native declared in common.ai).

UnitIsSleeping.zh: 单位当前是否正在睡眠。
UnitIsSleeping.en: Returns whether the unit is currently sleeping.

UnitItemInSlot.zh: 返回单位物品栏第 itemSlot 格（0~5）的物品，该格为空时返回 null。
UnitItemInSlot.en: Returns the item in inventory slot itemSlot (0-5); null if the slot is empty.

UnitMakeAbilityPermanent.zh: 设置单位的某个技能是否永久保留（单位变身后不会丢失），返回是否成功。
UnitMakeAbilityPermanent.en: Sets whether one of the unit's abilities is permanent (kept through morphs); returns success.

UnitModifySkillPoints.zh: 增减英雄的未分配技能点，skillPointDelta 可为负，返回是否成功。
UnitModifySkillPoints.en: Adds to or subtracts from a hero's unspent skill points (skillPointDelta may be negative); returns success.

UnitPauseTimedLife.zh: 暂停或恢复单位的生命周期倒计时，flag 为 true 暂停。
UnitPauseTimedLife.en: Pauses or resumes the unit's timed life countdown; flag true pauses it.

UnitPoolAddUnitType.zh: 向单位池加入一种单位类型及其抽取权重 weight。
UnitPoolAddUnitType.en: Adds a unit type with the given weight to a unit pool.

UnitPoolRemoveUnitType.zh: 从单位池移除一种单位类型。
UnitPoolRemoveUnitType.en: Removes a unit type from a unit pool.

UnitRemoveAbility.zh: 移除单位的某个技能，成功返回 true。
UnitRemoveAbility.en: Removes an ability from the unit; returns true on success.

UnitRemoveBuffs.zh: 移除单位身上的 buff：removePositive 移除正面 buff，removeNegative 移除负面 buff。
UnitRemoveBuffs.en: Removes buffs from the unit: removePositive removes positive buffs, removeNegative removes negative ones.

UnitRemoveBuffsEx.zh: 按条件移除单位身上的 buff，布尔参数依次筛选：正面、负面、魔法、物理、生命周期、光环、可自动驱散。
UnitRemoveBuffsEx.en: Removes buffs from the unit matching the filters: positive, negative, magic, physical, timed life, aura, auto-dispel.

UnitRemoveItem.zh: 把指定物品从单位物品栏中移出，物品掉在单位脚下。
UnitRemoveItem.en: Removes the item from the unit's inventory, dropping it at the unit's feet.

UnitRemoveItemFromSlot.zh: 把单位物品栏第 itemSlot 格（0~5）的物品移出并返回它（物品掉在地上）；空格返回 null。
UnitRemoveItemFromSlot.en: Removes the item in slot itemSlot (0-5) and returns it (it drops to the ground); null if the slot is empty.

UnitRemoveType.zh: 移除单位的一种单位分类（UNIT_TYPE_* 常量），返回是否成功。
UnitRemoveType.en: Removes a unit classification (UNIT_TYPE_* constant) from the unit; returns success.

UnitResetCooldown.zh: 重置单位所有技能的冷却时间。
UnitResetCooldown.en: Resets the cooldowns of all of the unit's abilities.

UnitSetConstructionProgress.zh: 设置正在建造的建筑的完成百分比（0~100）。
UnitSetConstructionProgress.en: Sets the construction progress percentage (0-100) of a building under construction.

UnitSetUpgradeProgress.zh: 设置正在升级的建筑的升级进度百分比（0~100）。
UnitSetUpgradeProgress.en: Sets the upgrade progress percentage (0-100) of an upgrading building.

UnitSetUsesAltIcon.zh: 设置单位在小地图上是否使用替代图标（图标由 SetAltMinimapIcon 设置）。
UnitSetUsesAltIcon.en: Sets whether the unit uses the alternate minimap icon (set via SetAltMinimapIcon).

UnitShareVision.zh: 设置是否把单位的视野共享给指定玩家，share 为 true 共享。
UnitShareVision.en: Shares or unshares the unit's vision with the given player; share true shares it.

UnitStripHeroLevel.zh: 把英雄降低 howManyLevels 级，返回是否成功。
UnitStripHeroLevel.en: Lowers the hero's level by howManyLevels; returns success.

UnitSuspendDecay.zh: 暂停或恢复单位尸体的腐烂，suspend 为 true 暂停。
UnitSuspendDecay.en: Suspends or resumes the decay of the unit's corpse; suspend true pauses it.

UnitUseItem.zh: 命令单位使用物品（无目标），返回是否成功。
UnitUseItem.en: Orders the unit to use an item with no target; returns success.

UnitUseItemPoint.zh: 命令单位对坐标 (x, y) 使用物品，返回是否成功。
UnitUseItemPoint.en: Orders the unit to use an item on the point (x, y); returns success.

UnitUseItemTarget.zh: 命令单位对目标（单位/物品/可破坏物）使用物品，返回是否成功。
UnitUseItemTarget.en: Orders the unit to use an item on a target widget; returns success.

UnregisterStackedSound.zh: 取消叠加声音的注册（RegisterStackedSound 的反操作），byPosition 为是否按位置，rectwidth/rectheight 为区域大小。
UnregisterStackedSound.en: Unregisters a stacked sound (reverse of RegisterStackedSound); byPosition selects position-based, rectwidth/rectheight give the area size.

Unsummon.zh: 电脑 AI 脚本用（common.ai）：对指定单位（通常是不死族建筑）执行解除召唤。只在 AI 脚本里有意义。
Unsummon.en: AI script only (common.ai): unsummons the given unit (typically an Undead building). Meaningful only in an AI script.

VersionCompatible.zh: 当前游戏是否兼容指定版本（VERSION_REIGN_OF_CHAOS 混乱之治 / VERSION_FROZEN_THRONE 冰封王座）。
VersionCompatible.en: Returns whether the running game is compatible with the given version (VERSION_REIGN_OF_CHAOS or VERSION_FROZEN_THRONE).

VersionGet.zh: 返回当前游戏版本（混乱之治或冰封王座）。
VersionGet.en: Returns the current game version (Reign of Chaos or The Frozen Throne).

VersionSupported.zh: 当前游戏是否支持指定版本（混乱之治 / 冰封王座）。
VersionSupported.en: Returns whether the running game supports the given version (Reign of Chaos / The Frozen Throne).

VolumeGroupReset.zh: 把所有音量组的音量恢复为默认值。
VolumeGroupReset.en: Resets all volume groups to their default volume.

VolumeGroupSetVolume.zh: 设置音量组（SOUND_VOLUMEGROUP_* 如单位音效、环境音、音乐）的音量比例，scale 取 0~1。
VolumeGroupSetVolume.en: Sets the volume scale (0-1) of a volume group (SOUND_VOLUMEGROUP_*, e.g. unit sounds, ambient, music).

WaitGetEnemyBase.zh: 电脑 AI 脚本用：查询 StartGetEnemyBase 发起的敌方基地搜索是否仍在进行（true 表示还需等待）。只在 AI 脚本里有意义。
WaitGetEnemyBase.en: AI script only: returns whether the enemy base search started by StartGetEnemyBase is still in progress (true means keep waiting).

WaygateActivate.zh: 启用或关闭传送门（waygate）单位，activate 为 true 启用。
WaygateActivate.en: Activates or deactivates a waygate unit; activate true enables it.

WaygateGetDestinationX.zh: 返回传送门目的地的 X 坐标。
WaygateGetDestinationX.en: Returns the X coordinate of the waygate's destination.

WaygateGetDestinationY.zh: 返回传送门目的地的 Y 坐标。
WaygateGetDestinationY.en: Returns the Y coordinate of the waygate's destination.

WaygateIsActive.zh: 传送门当前是否处于启用状态。
WaygateIsActive.en: Returns whether the waygate is currently active.

WaygateSetDestination.zh: 设置传送门的目的地坐标 (x, y)。
WaygateSetDestination.en: Sets the waygate's destination to (x, y).
